* '''Playtest''' ([[Beldon's Eye & •All My Urchins (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Text: “Deploy on table. * '''Original''' ([[Beldon's Eye & •All My Urchins]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019).
